claims.statement: In the account02/B19 exact no-coloop common-plane endpoint q=x^TBx+2x^TMy+y^T(Delta+M^TKM)y+affine, assume M has rank two and max normalized column leverage <=1/2. For invertible indefinite B let D=|det B|, kappa=sigma_min(B), G=MM^T and T=G^(1/2)(K-B^(-1))G^(1/2), with |theta1|=mu>=|theta2|. If mu>0, then if |theta2|>=mu/8, ||p_q||inf <=16*2^(5/8)(D*kappa*mu)^(-1/4); if |theta2|<mu/8, ||p_q||inf <=3*sqrt(2)*400^(1/3)(D^2*kappa*mu)^(-1/6). Thus the payment is uniform as the second mismatch eigenvalue tends to zero. Definite B has the separate direct pair bound pi/sqrt(|det B|).

For unit u with max_i u_i^2<=1/2 and every diagonal D0, ||D0+theta uu^T||op>=|theta|/4. More generally ||D0+theta uu^T+eps vv^T||op>=|theta|/4-|eps|. The proof uses a zero-diagonal nuclear-norm dual witness (uu^T-diag(u_i^2))/2.

The previously singular-looking rank-one endpoint is no longer a separate unpaid tube in the exact low-leverage no-coloop common-plane state. When |theta2|<mu/8, the actual completed remainder matrix has operator norm >mu/8 despite arbitrary diagonal twists; the completed arbitrary-rank quarter-power small-ball theorem then feeds the physical pair logarithmic transducer. No nonzero tail is deleted.
